style: Tilt-shift miniature diorama photographed with a macro lens, like a handcrafted stop-motion film set: tiny realistic figurines with soft matte skin and real fabric clothing, finely sculpted props, rich natural materials, warm volumetric sunlight, shallow depth of field with one sharp band across the middle of the frame and creamy blur at the top and bottom, gentle atmospheric haze, cinematic colour grade, warm amber highlights, soft blue shadows, high detail, 35mm film grain.
negative_video: Bright saturated tones, overexposed, static frame, blurry details, subtitles, text, logo, watermark, painting, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, deformed hands, extra fingers, malformed limbs, fused fingers, messy background, three legs, many people in the background, walking backwards, sudden cuts, morphing faces, flicker, zoom

characters.photographer: the photographer: a 41-year-old woman, 175 cm, 70 kg, slim, salt-and-pepper hair in a low bun, rectangular black glasses, charcoal quilted gilet over an oatmeal roll-neck sweater, olive canvas field trousers, brown hiking boots, holding a weathered tan mirrorless camera with a silver top plate and a worn brown leather strap up to her eye
characters.familyFall: a young family of four: a 34-year-old mother with shoulder-length dark brown hair in a mustard knit cardigan and jeans, a 36-year-old father with short black hair and a close beard in a rust flannel shirt and khaki chinos, a 6-year-old girl with curly dark pigtails in a red corduroy dress and white tights, a 3-year-old boy with fine dark hair in navy dungarees, and a golden retriever puppy

locations.fallPark: a small round floating island of autumn park drifting in the sky above soft clouds: a grassy top carpeted with fallen orange and yellow leaves, four sculpted autumn maple and oak trees in orange, red and gold, a red and white gingham picnic blanket with a wicker basket, a few small pumpkins, the island's underside a craggy rock and soil cone with hanging roots. Lighting plan: 1 PM autumn sun high from the upper left, warm 4500 K, dappled leaf shadows on the blanket, soft fill from the pale blue sky. Camera: 45 mm tilt-shift macro lens at f/2.8, elevated three-quarter view looking down about 30 degrees.
